title: Printer Page Plan Monitor for HP Instant Ink

user.title: Printer Page Plan Monitor for HP Instant Ink
user.description: Connect locally to a compatible printer and initialize the current page-plan cycle from the values shown by your subscription account.

data.monthly_pages: Pages included in the monthly plan
data.rollover_total_today: Rollover pages shown for this cycle

data_description.rollover_total_today: Enter the total rollover allowance shown by the subscription account (for example, 73 in '0 used of 73').
data_description.rollover_used_today: Enter how many rollover pages have already been used in the current cycle.
data_description.rollover_max: Enter the maximum rollover balance for your plan. For a 50-page plan with a 150-page rollover cap, enter 150.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the printer or the SubscriptionImpressions field is unavailable.
error.monthly_used_too_high: Monthly-plan pages used cannot exceed the monthly allowance.
error.rollover_total_too_high: The rollover allowance shown for this cycle cannot exceed the configured rollover maximum.
error.rollover_used_too_high: Rollover pages used cannot exceed the rollover allowance shown for this cycle.

init.title: Realign Printer Page Plan Monitor for HP Instant Ink
init.description: Enter the values currently shown by the subscription account. Saving creates a new anchor at the printer's current local page counter.
